rationale: This workspace contains one original research paper, not a systematic review. The bounded Zotero/Obsidian audit is complete for scope, nearest-work limits, comparator implications and claim boundaries; the review record is research/obsidian/07_Analysis/focused-audit-review-20260813.md. Dated Google/web refreshes on 2026-08-12, 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-14 added interaction, uncertainty, MPPI, self-supervised prediction, emergency-protection, CVaR/Bonferroni risk-mask, context-preference, official YOLO26-pose, Mecanum hardware, uncertainty-aware safety, model-based reinforcement learning, neural chance-constrained MPC, occlusion-aware MPC, model-free safety-critical MPC, Mecanum disturbance-observer MPC, learning-plus-MPC, current crowd-MPC, current hybrid Mecanum control, action-conditioned world models, flow-matching/MPPI, uncertainty-aware topological MPC and scenario-based collision-probability planning without claiming Google Scholar, Scopus, Web of Science, or IEEE Xplore coverage. The latest refresh confirms that self-supervised motion learning, RL, neural chance control, occlusion-aware safety, model-free safety, multisensor crowd MPC, Mecanum hybrid control, ADE, world-model planning, flow-matching/MPPI, topology-aware risk and joint collision-probability planning do not replace matched closed-loop or human-centred evaluation; the hardware refresh confirms that Astra-S/OpenNI2 branch identity, N10P revision/baud, Jetson ARM64 runtime and Raspberry Pi serial/CAN availability must be measured on the supplied units rather than inferred. The 2026-08-13 attention/interaction refresh adds screening-only records for pedestrian-attention-aware collision avoidance and robot-pedestrian influence data; these strengthen interaction-condition and metadata obligations without changing the bounded CCA position-state NMPC gap. These checks narrow evidence obligations but do not change the bounded CCA position-state NMPC gap. A 2026-08-13 Google Scholar spot-check returned unstable author-profile/mixed discovery pages rather than a directly matched primary record, so no Scholar result was counted or imported. The latest learning/control and attention/interaction records had no match in a read-only Zotero local search and remain screening-only. Screening-only records remain explicitly labelled and are not final quantitative citations. SICNav is checked against Zotero full text, and Stefanini et al. is re-matched to Zotero item 8T4BRJA4; its existing NW-01 full-text extraction is retained while later notes record landing-page/metadata refreshes. PR01 search plans and candidate exports remain historical provenance only. The 2026-08-14 four-record overlap audit, current control/perception refresh and continuation web check are linked in research/obsidian/03_Literature/web-verified-gap-sources.md and research/obsidian/03_Literature/current-research-refresh-20260814.md; these records are not Zotero admissions. This completion does not admit data, checkpoints, simulations or hardware evidence; those remain separate protocol gates.
